entry.title: Signal 36: the Android profiler that kills your shell scripts
entry.summary: Roughly one in eight short-lived processes on Android dies with exit 164. traced_perf sends BIONIC_SIGNAL_PROFILER (kernel signal 36), and the default disposition of a real-time signal is terminate. Measured kill rates, the spawn-count rule, the one-line fix, and what is still unexplained.

entry.title: Building Android apps on an ARM64 phone
entry.summary: Google's Linux Android SDK tools are x86-64 only. The aapt2 override, the compileSdk 37 hand-install, and the Gradle traps that cost the most time when building on an ARM64 device.
